title: RAS 2026 demand.csv row
description: Schema for one row of demand.csv. Demand scaling scenarios are represented by the demand_multiplier row in setting.csv, not by separate scaled_demand files. See spec v1.5 §3.3.

origin_yard_id.description: Origin yard node_id. Must reference a node.csv row with node_type='yard'.

dest_yard_id.description: Destination yard node_id. Must reference a node.csv row with node_type='yard'.

volume.description: Demand volume in car-equivalent units over the operating cycle. Baseline demand.csv ships integer car counts; apply setting.csv:demand_multiplier for the corresponding scenario as needed. Solvers should treat the value as numeric.

block_type.description: Commodity-derived block category. Merchandise/Coal/Grain are classification commodities (Manifest/Bulk blocks). Intermodal and Automobile are restricted to direct (single-block) blocking sequences per v1.5 §1.1.
